boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Otterbein University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with currently listed late availability on campus or in Westerville.

cards.title: The Nest late-night menu
cards.subtitle: Campus Center • Otterbein University
cards.notes: Use the dining site to confirm the late-night menu, then plan a Campus Center stop before its listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining with late-night service on multiple evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein Dining lists The Nest late-night menu through 11:30 PM Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and through 12:00 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed late-night hours: Mon–Thu and Sun until 11:30 PM; Fri and Sat until 12:00 AM. Hours may vary during breaks.

cards.title: The OtterDen
cards.subtitle: Campus Center • Otterbein University
cards.notes: Check the dining page for the current schedule, then use the Campus Center location while it remains open into the evening.
cards.short_summary: Campus Center grab-and-go venue with listed 11 PM closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein Dining lists The OtterDen open until 11:00 PM Monday–Friday and 2:00 PM–11:00 PM Saturday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11:00 AM–11:00 PM weekdays; 2:00 PM–11:00 PM weekends. The page notes locations may have seasonal variations.

cards.title: Mashawee Stop Mediterranean Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 117 Westerville Plaza • Westerville
cards.notes: Confirm the current hours on Mashawee Stop’s site, then place an order or visit before the late listed closing window.
cards.short_summary: Mediterranean restaurant with midnight service most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Mashawee Stop lists hours until 11:59 PM Sunday–Thursday and until 1:00 AM early Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sun–Thu 10:00 AM–11:59 PM; Friday and Saturday include 12:00 AM–1:00 AM service. Verify before travel.

cards.title: Wendy’s on South State Street
cards.subtitle: 589 S State Street • Westerville
cards.notes: Use Wendy’s official location page to check restaurant or drive-thru service, then plan around its listed 1 AM close.
cards.short_summary: A Westerville Wendy’s with restaurant and drive-thru hours to 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours at 589 S State Street until 1:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Listed restaurant and drive-thru hours are until 1:00 AM every day.

cards.title: Papa Johns Pizza on South State Street
cards.subtitle: 503 S State Street • Westerville
cards.notes: Check the official page for the current carryout or delivery window, then order with its late listed service in mind.
cards.short_summary: Pizza carryout and delivery with 1–2 AM listed availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists carryout and delivery until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 AM Friday and Saturday at 503 S State Street.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza, 503 S State Street
cards.access_notes: Listed carryout and delivery close at 1:00 AM Sun–Thu and 2:00 AM Fri–Sat.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill on South State Street
cards.subtitle: 641 S State Street • Westerville
cards.notes: Review the location page before going, then use its 11 PM daily closing time as the latest planned arrival boundary.
cards.short_summary: Customizable Mexican grill with 11 PM daily listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists restaurant hours of 10:45 AM–11:00 PM daily at 641 S State Street in Westerville.
cards.source_title: Chipotle Mexican Grill, 641 S State Street
cards.access_notes: Listed restaurant hours are 10:45 AM–11:00 PM Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Domino’s on Westerville Road
cards.subtitle: 5864 Westerville Road • Westerville
cards.notes: Check the store’s official page immediately before ordering, then choose delivery or carryout while the posted late window is active.
cards.short_summary: Westerville pizza location currently displaying a midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 5864 Westerville Road states the Westerville location is open until 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently displays ‘Open Today Until 12:00 AM’; confirm day-specific timing before travel.

cards.title: KFC on South State Street
cards.subtitle: 525 S State Street • Westerville
cards.notes: Use KFC’s official location page to check service before departure, then arrive before the published 11 PM daily close.
cards.short_summary: Westerville KFC with a consistent 11 PM listed close.
cards.evidence_claim: KFC lists 10:00 AM–11:00 PM hours every day for its restaurant at 525 S State Street in Westerville.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 10:00 AM–11:00 PM Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South State Street
cards.subtitle: 651 S State Street • Westerville
cards.notes: Confirm the selected service type on Pizza Hut’s location page, then place a carryout or delivery order before the listed close.
cards.short_summary: Pizza option listed until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists restaurant hours until 11:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and until 12:00 AM Friday and Saturday at 651 S State Street.
cards.access_notes: Listed restaurant hours: until 11:00 PM Sun–Thu and 12:00 AM Fri–Sat; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Schrock Road
cards.subtitle: 26 E Schrock Road • Westerville
cards.notes: Check the drive-thru schedule on Taco Bell’s official page before leaving, since the dining room closes earlier than the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: Drive-thru destination with a listed 5 AM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 9:00 AM–5:00 AM daily at 26 E Schrock Road; its listed dine-in hours close earlier.
cards.access_notes: Listed drive-thru hours are 9:00 AM–5:00 AM daily. The dine-in listing closes at 11:00 PM, so use the appropriate service option.
